decisive_items: Raynaud’s phenomenon was elicited by cold‐water immersion of the hands
pulmonary arterial systolic pressure (PASP) of 80 mm Hg
response.rationale: Anti-centromere antibody positivity and Raynaud phenomenon are hallmarks of limited systemic sclerosis, and the pulmonary hypertension is best explained as a complication of this connective tissue disease rather than as idiopathic PAH.

rejected.why: Pulmonary hypertension is present, but the anti-centromere antibody and Raynaud phenomenon indicate an underlying limited systemic sclerosis, making idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension less likely.
